description: Keyphrase extraction (RAKE, offline) — Extract the key phrases and top words from any text with RAKE (word degree/frequency scoring) plus stemming and a frequency boost - offline, deterministic, no AI. Returns ranked multi-word keyphrases with scores and counts, top content words, and text stats (words, unique words, lexical diversity). Optional: top (1-50, default 15), min_count. Up to 200,000 chars. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
